QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] A Rest for Weary Warriors
QuestInfo.0: You defeated #o9402052# and #o9402053# monsters so the people in the Land of Warriors could take the day off tomorrow. Hurry up and #ebring on the day time before the monster can recover!#n\r\n
QuestInfo.1: You hunt monsters all night so the people in the Land of Warriors can spend a day relaxing. But instead of thanking you, they were furious!\r\nThey say that fighting monsters is their duty and that battle brings them joy...\r\nThey demand that you turn the day into night IMMEDIATELY!
QuestInfo.2: Your attempts to do a favor for the warriors has ended in disaster. They must be tired from all their endless fighting. You should give them a longer night so they can rest.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: #questorder1#Change day into night using the Solar Pulley (#R63090ExDnNRef63061#)
